services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Skydive Newport has been providing safe, world-class tandem skydiving in New England since 1999. Our skydiving center is just a short 90-minute drive from the Boston, MA metro area. Our incredible coastal views, proximity to historic Newport, RI and impeccable safety record have made us the #1 choice for tandem skydiving near Boston for more than 15 years. We host hundreds of guests every year from the Boston metro area. If you’re thinking about making a tandem skydive in New England, there’s no better place to do it than Skydive Newport! blurb: Guests participate in a tandem skydive with a certified instructor using a parachute built for two. Training takes about 5 minutes, followed by a 40-second freefall at 120 mph and a 5 to 10 minute parachute descent. The dropzone is located near Newport's historic coastline and offers a scenic view during the descent.
